name: Gad
description: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy

points: In the morning the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, David's seer, offering David three things to choose one: seven years of famine, three months fleeing before his enemies, or three days of pestilence. David was in a great strait and said, Let us fall now into the hand of the Lord, for his mercies are great, and let me not fall into the hand of man. He had two prophets, Gad and Nathan, who ministered to him.

note.label: 2 Samuel 24: David Numbers Israel and Buys the Threshing Floor

points: The angel commanded Gad to tell David to set up an altar in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, and David went up at the word spoken in the name of the Most High.
Hezekiah sets the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, psalteries, and harps according to the commandment of David, Gad the seer, and Nathan the prophet.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 29: Hezekiah Cleanses the House of the Lord
